findings.impact: S9 is required for every current package, including the pending list, and T1/T2 were removed from those paths. Ownership runs only on calls inside the raw up() body, and only when the second argument is an inline function. A create that the previous whole-file Schema::create scan would report now exits 0 through both schema-gate and table-ownership-gate.
findings.counterexample: Put this file in packages/core/database/migrations/pg, a directory listed in scripts/schema-sets.json. schema-gate and table-ownership-gate both exit 0. Inline the same Schema::create in up() and S9 fires because zzz_not_in_catalog is absent from docs/architecture/table-ownership.md. The skip is product/scripts/table-ownership-gate.php:53. The same hole is product/scripts/schema-gate.php:148 for Schema::create('zzz_not_in_catalog', $blueprint) in up() itself.
findings.owning_correction: P08.3: run the S9 create/CREATE TABLE scan, and the baseline S3/S4/S6 scan, over every helper body already collected for S5/S7, and treat Schema::create/table as ownership even when the blueprint is not an inline function. Keep T1/T2 off registered paths only after that parity exists.

findings.impact: Section 5 requires every catalogue name to be at most 63 bytes. SchemaGoldenTest.php:38 enforces that on PostgreSQL. SchemaSqliteGoldenTest never does, and the committed SQLite golden already contains longer names. One of them is not the name SQLite stored: autoindex recovery fails and the fallback invents table_kind_columns.
findings.counterexample: product/tests/Golden/schema/tenant.sqlite.json:446 is corex_reference_aliases_pk_snapshot_id_namespace_source_id_locale_alias (71 bytes), the fallback at SchemaCatalogue.php:140. SQLite's row is sqlite_autoindex_corex_reference_aliases_1. product/tests/Golden/schema/tenant.sqlite.json:4092 is the stored Laravel name ntf_notifications_recipient_kind_recipient_id_request_key_unique (64 bytes). SchemaSqliteGoldenTest.php:41 compares JSON only, so both stay green, including after GOLDEN_UPDATE=1.
findings.owning_correction: P08.3: publish the recovered or stored identifier, assert strlen <= 63 on the SQLite catalogue the same way as PostgreSQL, and put any current stored name that is still over 63 on a shrinking ratchet. Do not rename shipped DDL in this item.

recommendations: S4 does not bind sprintf constraint names. product/packages/operations/database/migrations/budget/create_sys_api_budget_tables.php:39 passes budget_buckets_counts into addCheck(), whose SQL format string lives in the helper. The SQL scan at product/scripts/schema-gate.php:231 reads only literal CONSTRAINT/INDEX tokens in up(), so removing axiomasoft/corex-operations from the pending list still will not flag that name. The same pattern is in the bulk and webhook migrations.

S3 does not treat foreignId()/foreignUuid()->references()->on() without ->name() as an unnamed foreign key (product/scripts/schema-gate.php:179). constrained(), morphs, and ->foreign($columns) are covered.
S4 accepts an object whose name merely starts with the enclosed table plus an underscore, so table user admits users_id_fk.

crm_leads.score is in product/scripts/schema-gate-allowlist.json:2 and is absent from product/tests/Golden/schema/tenant.pgsql.json. It is a latent S6 exemption if the column is gone; confirm before flex/crm leaves pending. The ratchet compares allowlist keys only, not reason text.
axiomasoft/corex-operations:budget declares sqlite, but the only SQLite golden is tenant scope. The sqlite branch of addCheck() is outside SchemaSqliteGoldenTest and SchemaGoldenTest.

SnapshotSchemaTest.php:34 takes the connection from the first id and calls migrateSets once. A combined operations tenant+budget SNAPSHOT_SETS value throws because LaravelSchemaMigrator rejects mixed scopes.

schema-sets.json records connection schema_budget because SchemaGate::manifest() overrides corex-operations.schema before reading the registry. --check matches that hermetic boot; it does not watch the production connection name.

tenant.sqlite.json locks AccountFixture tables users, wsp_workspaces, and wsp_workspace_members into the schema-set snapshot. PostgreSQL crm_sources unique columns are (workspace_id, code); SQLite records COALESCE(workspace_id, ''). That driver split belongs to baseline normalization.

32-bit counters visible in the PostgreSQL goldens (attempt, attempts, position, minutes, db_count, version, batch_seq, last_activity, replay_count) are correctly absent from the allowlist and stay pending-exempt until P08.4–P08.8.
S8's fixed-date branch and S4's duplicate-name branch are implemented; the S8 fixture only changes version.
coverage: Read-only review of the snapshot: norms P08.3, D110, D111, D113, dossier sections 4, 5, and 6.3, examples sections 6, 9, and 10; schema-gate.php, pending/allowlist/sets, SchemaGateTest and S1–S9 fixtures; table-ownership-gate.php T1/T2 handoff and retained T4; anti-weakening inventory ratchet; composer scripts and ci.yml schema-gate, golden, and test:pg lanes; SchemaCatalogue, both golden tests, SnapshotSchemaTest, SchemaEnvironment, and the four golden JSON files; the three up() connection repairs, both retention harnesses, crm_sources row, and provider manifests under dependencies. Validation logs V1–V6, V8, V9, V14–V17, related, and negative.txt show green exits and byte-identical rollback; they were not re-executed. Current tree S9 matches the catalogue. Pending still disables only S2/S3/S4/S6/S8. Schema::getConnection() keeps the edited DDL intact and is not an S7 hit.
